keys.cd_realtor: Rent and purchase of premium real estate: apartments, houses and seaside villas, trusted realtors and agencies. We will help you find a home for the season or for good and support the deal.
keys.cd_transport: Helicopters, yachts, cars, motorbikes and boats with or without crew. Premium transport for leisure and business trips: fast, safe, delivered to a convenient place.
keys.cd_restaurant: Restaurants, cafes and patisseries with excellent cuisine and service. National dishes, signature menus, private chefs and closed dinners for those who value taste and privacy.
keys.cd_nightlife: Late-night restaurants, clubs, lounges and beach clubs. Places where the evening goes on after midnight: music, shows, VIP tables and an atmosphere worth telling friends about.
keys.cd_excursion: Group and private tours, sea trips, mountains, jeeping and diving. Vivid experiences from trusted guides and organizers, routes to match your pace and budget.
keys.cd_beauty: Hairdressers, barbershops, nails, brows and lashes, cosmetology. Masters you can trust: careful work, good service and a result that pleases every day.
keys.cd_style: Tattoo artists, piercing, makeup artists, permanent makeup and stylists. Image and self-expression: an individual approach, sterility and respect for your taste.
keys.cd_health: Health food stores, fitness clubs, yoga, nutritionists and personal trainers. Everything for shape and energy: healthy products, workouts and expert advice.
keys.cd_spa: Spa salons, massage, banyas and saunas, wellness retreats and thalassotherapy. A reset for body and mind: silence, aromas, experienced masters and a private atmosphere.
keys.cd_medicine: Private clinics, dentistry, diagnostics, medical cosmetology and psychotherapy. Modern equipment, experienced doctors, appointments without queues and care for your health.
keys.cd_petcare: 24-hour pharmacies, veterinary clinics, pet shops, grooming and pet hotels. Care for you and your pets at any time, wherever you vacation.
keys.cd_legal: Lawyers, advocates, notaries, mediators and patent attorneys. Protection of your interests and support for deals: clear terms, confidentiality and responsibility for the result.
keys.cd_events: Turnkey weddings, hosts and performers, villa and venue rental, decor, flowers, shows and fireworks. We organize an event people will talk about: from the idea to the last guest.
keys.cd_concierge: Concierge service, private drivers, security, nannies, governesses and villa managers. Your comfort and safety without worries: reliable people, verified agencies and full confidentiality.
keys.cd_boutique: Boutiques, jewelry and watches, perfumery, premium gifts, local wines and delicacies. Worthy items and gifts with a good story, chosen with attention to detail.
keys.cd_tourservice: Photo and video, translators, travel insurance, visas and documents, mobile and internet. Everything that makes a trip easier: fast, in a clear language and without hassle.
keys.cd_finance: Banks and loans, crypto wallets and exchange, trading and brokers, insurance and investments. Licensed financial partners: clear terms, protection of funds and honest information about risks.
keys.cd_leisure: Casinos, poker clubs, betting, esports and VIP tickets for shows and sports. Gaming and leisure for adults 18+ only with licensed organizers and only where the law allows.
